consequence: FAIL under the registered rule: relay_stall_policy stays legacy and SP10 is not merged. The hard checks pass; the failure is power: no key cell survives Holm.
analysis: 0 of 6 key cells improved after Holm (4 required). One-sided unadjusted p: mixed/4MiB/30Mbit 0.013, mixed/4MiB/60Mbit 0.0275, mixed/16MiB/8Mbit 0.0399, mixed/4MiB/8Mbit 0.0488, mixed/16MiB/30Mbit 0.2131, mixed/16MiB/60Mbit 0.4571; the smallest (0.013) is above the first Holm threshold 0.05/6 = 0.0083, so Holm stops there.

The mean start time is lower with the watchdog in every key cell, clearly in 5 of 6: mixed/4MiB/8Mbit 12.37 -> 8.06 s; mixed/4MiB/30Mbit 15.14 -> 9.5 s; mixed/4MiB/60Mbit 15.93 -> 11.86 s; mixed/16MiB/8Mbit 16.91 -> 13.03 s; mixed/16MiB/30Mbit 17.83 -> 15.37 s; mixed/16MiB/60Mbit 18.25 -> 17.95 s. C0 is bimodal (a fast start, or roughly 15-37 s when a stalled peer holds a boundary piece); CW removes many of the slow starts but not all (several 16-24 s remain), and with SD 3-9 s at n = 10 per arm no single cell is conclusive.

Hard checks pass: 0 bans in the 60 CW runs of the fast, thin and slowlive cells (no false ban); every CW run of a mixed cell banned 1-2 peers (70/70 runs, 126 bans, the profile has 2 stalled peers); 0 bans in C0; 0 failed runs, 0 app tracebacks, 0 infrastructure retries.

No guard regression after Holm over 52 tests. Unadjusted (descriptive, not significant after Holm): mixed/1MiB/30Mbit seek.resume_s (+0.43 s, p 0.044); mixed/4MiB/60Mbit seek.resume_s (+0.37 s, p 0.032); the mixed/1MiB/30Mbit start time 7.94 -> 9.11 s (n.s.). Small pieces deserve a guard in any repeat.

Planning number for a powered repeat (not a decision): at the median effect size d = 0.77 of the cells with a visible gain, one-sided alpha 0.05/6 and 80 % power need about 35 runs per arm and cell, i.e. about 420 runs (~5.6 h at this gate's 48 s per run) for the 6 mixed key cells alone. A repeat would be a new, pre-registered version on new data; v1 stays FAIL and is not pooled.
